Supplier.title: Supplier
Supplier.description: Supplier directory record with communication channels, specific products list, WhatsApp deep links, Facebook links, pricing details, and admin visibility controls.

ownerId.description: User ID of the supplier owner

cleanPhone.description: Sanitized numeric phone digits for wa.me links

facebookUrl.description: URL to Facebook profile or business page

communicationChannels.description: Selected communication channels (whatsapp, phone, facebook, telegram, email, imo)

location.description: Physical address, city, or market location

categories.description: Product categories or item types supplied

products.description: Specific product names provided by this supplier

pricingCatalog.description: Price range, catalog details, or payment terms

notes.description: Internal notes, delivery speed, advance requirements

tags.description: Labels such as Priority, Backup, Wholesale

isPricingHidden.description: Whether product pricing is hidden by admin

isNotesHidden.description: Whether custom notes are hidden by admin

isHidden.description: Whether supplier is hidden from standard view

/suppliers/{supplierId}.description: Collection of suppliers owned and managed by the authenticated user
